en.text: Hear, LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你侧耳应允我，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你側耳應允我，

en.text: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.

zhSimplified.text: 求你保存我的性命，因我是虔诚人。

zhTraditional.text: 求你保存我的性命，因我是虔誠人。

en.text: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.
Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.

zhSimplified.text: 主啊，求你使仆人心里欢喜，

zhTraditional.text: 主啊，求你使僕人心裏歡喜，

en.text: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

zhSimplified.text: 主啊，你本为良善，乐意饶恕人，

zhTraditional.text: 主啊，你本為良善，樂意饒恕人，

en.text: Hear, LORD, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你留心听我的祷告，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你留心聽我的禱告，

en.text: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.

zhSimplified.text: 我在患难之日要求告你，

zhTraditional.text: 我在患難之日要求告你，

en.text: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, deeds like your deeds.

zhSimplified.text: 主啊，诸神之中没有可比你的；

zhTraditional.text: 主啊，諸神之中沒有可比你的；

en.text: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.

zhSimplified.text: 主啊，你所造的万民都要来敬拜你；

zhTraditional.text: 主啊，你所造的萬民都要來敬拜你；

en.text: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.

zhSimplified.text: 因你为大，且行奇妙的事；

zhTraditional.text: 因你為大，且行奇妙的事；

en.text: Teach me your way, LORD. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你将你的道指教我；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你將你的道指教我；

en.text: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.

zhSimplified.text: 主—我的 神啊，我要一心称赞你；

zhTraditional.text: 主－我的上帝啊，我要一心稱讚你；

en.text: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.

footnotes.text: 86:13 Sheol is the place of the dead.

zhSimplified.text: 因为，你向我发的慈爱是大的；

zhTraditional.text: 因為，你向我發的慈愛是大的；

en.text: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.

zhSimplified.text: 神啊，骄傲的人起来攻击我，

zhTraditional.text: 上帝啊，驕傲的人起來攻擊我，

en.text: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.

zhSimplified.text: 主啊，你是有怜悯有恩典的 神，

zhTraditional.text: 主啊，你是有憐憫有恩典的上帝，

en.text: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.
Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, LORD, have helped me, and comforted me.

zhSimplified.text: 求你向我显出恩待我的凭据，

zhTraditional.text: 求你向我顯出恩待我的憑據，
